$comment: INFRA-040 — the raw-control ratchet. This file is the WHOLE definition of the check: what is banned, where it is banned, who is permanently exempt, and who is grandfathered. `eslint.config.js` reads it and builds `no-restricted-syntax` blocks from it, so the rule and its baseline can never disagree. It rides the gates that already exist — `npx eslint $staged_ts` in .githooks/pre-commit and `npm run lint` in CI — and adds no hook step and no CI step (sprint-026 P6). `baseline` is a RATCHET: an entry may shrink or disappear, never appear. The closed census it may not exceed is pinned in scripts/raw-controls-ratchet.test.ts. Migrating a file means DELETING its entry here — the test fails on an entry whose file no longer carries a raw control, and once the entry is gone the file is locked out and can never take one back.

banned.message: A raw <button> is not the product's button. Use Button, IconButton or Chip from @corpus/kit — one shape, one focus ring, one set of tokens (INFRA-040). The grandfathered files are listed in scripts/raw-controls-baseline.json, and that list may only shrink.
A raw <select> renders native chrome the product does not use. Use Select from @corpus/kit — the pill trigger with the custom menu (INFRA-040). No file is grandfathered for <select>.
A raw <option> only exists inside a native dropdown. Pass the choices to Select from @corpus/kit as its `items` prop instead (INFRA-040). No file is grandfathered for <option>.
